propositions: The ownership-direction gate and field-consumption gate run only in the standalone workflow step today, not in make lint, fragmenting the trigger across CI-only and portable paths
Wiring both gates into the Makefile lint target enables CI to inherit them via its existing make lint step, eliminating the need for a separate standalone workflow step and preventing double-run
The ee2a if-present guard becomes redundant once gate invocations move to make lint, since a patchset predating the Makefile changes will simply omit the gate lines and pass naturally
The test_ci_wires_the_gate assertion must be re-anchored from the workflow to the Makefile lint target to validate gate wiring after the standalone step is removed
The workflow-parity tests must assert both gate invocations exist in the Makefile lint target and that CI still runs make lint, so removal of either gate or the make lint step fails the parity check
